name: Kashi Ropeway (Cantt to Godowlia)
address: Cantt station to Godowlia Chowk, Varanasi
summary: India's first urban passenger ropeway, being built between Cantt station and Godowlia. Official status, stations and what we know.
description: Official facts gathered (publish once a licensed photo is available): NHLML lists the project as 'Under Implementation' (no official opening date, hours or fares yet); 3.85 km monocable detachable gondola; stations named in tenders: Varanasi Cantt, Vidyapith, Rathyatra, Godowlia Chowk; foundation stone 24 Mar 2023 (PIB); PIB Parvatmala note (Mar 2025): 148 cabins, up to 96,000 passengers a day. It does not go to the stadium. [ADD FIRST-HAND] photo.
